crossRefs.note: Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, including Jericho.”…
Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the children of Israel. No one went out, and no one came in.
Joshua commanded them with an oath at that time, saying, “Cursed is the man before Yahweh who rises up and builds this…
So Yahweh was with Joshua; and his fame was in all the land.
In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up…
They came back to him, while he stayed at Jericho; and he said to them, “Didn’t I tell you, ‘Don’t go?’ ”

people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel
